{{Quote|I wonder what happened to her family.''"<br />"''Probably dead.|[[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], on Numa|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>}}
A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]''' was an inhabitant of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], where he lived with his family during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He often became concerned about his young daughter, [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], who constantly explored the shelter tunnels under their [[Numa's home/Legends|home]]. Fearing that she could get lost inside the tunnels, he forbade Numa from going there alone, although Numa disobeyed his orders. One night in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Numa followed a [[Separatist probe droid/Legends|recon droid]] inside the tunnels&mdash;inadvertently, at the exact moment that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] Ryloth. As part of the invasion, the Separatists subjugated Nabat, and Numa's [[Parent/Legends|father]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] alongside his [[Numa's mother/Legends|wife]], leaving their daughter orphaned.

==Biography==
{{Quote|How was the market, love?''»<br />«''The usual. Though Tronda says a storm is coming.''»<br />«''Tronda. Always seeing things.''»<br />«''Still, would be good to get the shelter cleared.|translated=1|Numa's father and mother|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:NumasFamily-Curfew.png|thumb|left|250px|Numa's family]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] lived in [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He fell in love with a [[Numa's mother/Legends|female Twi'lek]],<ref name="Curfew" /> and, around [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /><ref name="DB" /> the two had a daughter whom they named [[Numa/Legends|Numa]].<ref name="Curfew" /> The family also included [[Nilim Bril/Legends|Nilim Bril]], Numa's uncle,<ref name="EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> and the family was befriended by the female Twi'lek [[Tronda]].<ref name="Curfew" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|five years later]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> while the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Numa's [[Parent/Legends|mother]] took her young daughter to a local market. Meanwhile, Numa's father found his daughter's [[Tooka doll/Legends|Tooka doll]] inside the shelter tunnels under their [[Numa's home/Legends|home]], and he deduced that Numa had been playing there without permission.<ref name="Curfew" />

When Numa and her mother returned, the elder female Twi'lek reported that Tronda had felt a "storm" approaching, and Numa's father comforted his love before turning his attention to Numa. When her father asked how her doll had ended up in the tunnels, Numa explained that the doll had been following a "[[Separatist probe droid/Legends|bright-eye]]," but her father did not believe her. Reproving Numa for fibbing, Numa's father reminded her that she was not allowed to go down to the tunnels alone, as she could easily get lost there. Later that night, however, the "bright-eye"&mdash;which was actually a Confederate [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droid]]&mdash;appeared again in the tunnels, and Numa pursued it there. At the exact moment, the storm Tronda had felt arrived on Ryloth in the form of an [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invasion]] launched by the Confederacy, and Nabat sustained serious damage. While Numa survived the attack by taking shelter in the tunnels, many other Twi'leks were captured by the invading Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Curfew" /> Both Numa's father and mother [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the raid, orphaning the young Twi'lek.<ref name="DB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't fib, Numa. We've told you before we don't want you to play in the shelter tunnels alone. You could get lost.|translated=1|Numa's father|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
Numa's father cared strongly about his family. Fearing that Numa could get lost inside the shelter tunnels, he did not permit his young daughter to enter them alone. He was not very trusting and did not believe in Tronda's feelings about the approaching "storm" or Numa's explanation about the "bright-eye"; in the latter situation, he believed that his daughter was simply lying. A native to the planet Ryloth, he spoke [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]].<ref name="Curfew" />

==Behind the scenes==
Numa's family was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]," although her father was not specifically referenced. The father later appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Curfew]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' comic series]] that led into the episode. While the father's death was not directly mentioned in the comic, [http://www.starwars.com/databank/character/numa/index.html Numa's entry] in the official [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] and the [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|accompanying online guide]] for "Innocents of Ryloth" described Numa as an orphan, suggesting that her parents had been killed.
